model_defaults: sklearn defaults except n_estimators, max_features=sqrt, random_state, n_jobs; runtime-only preflight amended before performance inspection
distance: train median/IQR Euclidean nearest; IQR=0 falls back train population SD then 1; train LOO q95 linear
role_policy: primary role-specific linker vocabularies and ordered keys; union and sorted-key sensitivity, because exchangeability unverified
sparse_category_rule: n<30 or unique ordered coarse<5; descriptive only
fingerprints: not available unless independently validated mapping acquired; never use ID distances
sampling: sample once then filter finite scalar/target and negative scalar values; no refill
screening: pooled OOF retrospective ranking, not single-model deployment
